# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta19

This beta compacts the map-card header and moves the Gate Area editor trigger out of the map canvas.

## Changed

- Remove the visible **History**, **Notifications** and **Schedule** text labels from the card header.
- Keep the same actions as icon-only buttons with their existing tooltip/title and accessibility labels.
- Move the Gate Area editor trigger from the floating map button into the header.
- Use `mdi:vector-square-edit` for the Gate Area editor trigger: a vector/polygon-style shape with an edit pencil.
- Keep the Gate Area selector/menu and editing panel map-local so the editing workflow itself is unchanged.
- Keep the Gate Area editor action immediately before **Settings** when the Settings button is present.
- Keep unread Notifications and active History/Schedule/Gate-editor states using their existing accent behavior.

## Header order

History → Notifications → Schedule → Gate Area Edit → Settings

The card title still uses the remaining horizontal space, while the action buttons now use a consistent 34 px circular icon footprint.
